title: Launch Party
one_paragraph_synopsis: In this episode, Michael launches the Dunder-Mifflin Infinity website and plans a launch party to rival the New York event, while Dwight challenges the website in a sales competition. Angela struggles with party preparations and personal frustrations, including a typo on a banner and cutlery issues. Meanwhile, Michael holds a pizza delivery guy hostage over a discount dispute, causing office tension. Romantic tensions arise as Andy expresses interest in Angela, who rejects him, and Jim and Pam reminisce about their relationship. The episode ends with party plans underway and unresolved conflicts and uncertainties about relationships and event outcomes.

main_threads.thread: The launch of the Dunder-Mifflin Infinity website and the associated launch party plans, including Michael's ambition to outshine the New York event and Angela's involvement and frustrations.
